about_the_game:
This is a demo version of the game "Stellar Freight: Echoes of the Void", where you can try out some of the main gameplay mechanics. The demo includes only a small part of the full experience that will be available in the final game.

Included in the demo:

  • Travel with only one life across 200 days (steps)

  • Battles with enemy ships

  • Ability to take on simple quests

  • Ability to upgrade your ship’s stats

  • Option to buy a new ship hull

  • Some text-based quests in dialogue format

  • Possibility to find crew members and level them up

At this stage, the narrative part of the project is not fully represented. The demo is designed to give players a general idea of what the full version will be like and to spark interest. We also hope to collect feedback to understand what can already be improved. Suggestions and thoughts about the project are welcome.

Currently, the game supports only Ukrainian and English. In the future, closer to release, we plan to add more languages. The full version will also include much more content and new gameplay mechanics - so stay tuned!

short_description: Take command of a freight ship traveling through deep space. Every jump brings danger, every decision matters. Manage your crew, upgrade your ship, trade, fight, and survive in a hostile galaxy where resources are scarce and every day could be your last.
